name: Sara Anne Winder, Prince of San Francisco

system.concept: Camarilla Prince of San Francisco, strategist of the New York reconquista
system.biography:
Background

Sara Anne Winder, firstborn of English nobleman Roger Winder, was educated as a man's equal and graduated (secretly, as a woman) from Oxford with honors before the university revoked her degree upon discovering the deception. Embraced by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} elder Charlotte Ingraham after two years of cultivation, Winder became a strong proponent of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} ideals and rose to prominence as one of the strategists behind the reconquest of New York City. That success won her the Inner Circle's blessing to become Prince of San Francisco — on the condition she first retake the city from the Kuei-jin who seized it from her predecessor, Jochen Van Nuys.

Roleplaying Hints

Winder is a battle-hardened general in the guise of a sweet, flirtatious young woman: gracious even to enemies, willing to use any tactic to win, but never gratuitously cruel. She waits on Inner Circle authorization for a mass-Embrace campaign to retake the city outright, relying in the meantime on agents like Kelvin Wee, her bodyguard Miriam Caravaggio, and the loyalty of Kokopell Mana and Luna Demian.
system.notes: Sire: Charlotte Ingraham. Bodyguard: Miriam Caravaggio (@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador}). Key allies: Kokopell Mana (@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} primogen), Luna Demian (@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} Regent), Kelvin Wee (@UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} negotiator with the Mandarinate). Disciplines (as printed): Auspex 2, Celerity 4, Dominate 5, Fortitude 4, Potence 2, Presence 5.

system.description: Rather than requiring eye contact, you may use Dominate through skin-to-skin contact alone (a Physical Challenge may be needed on unwilling subjects). The touch need not be maintained while issuing the command, but only one command may be given per contact; using Dominate again requires touching the subject anew.

Commands you implant via Dominate become extremely resistant to being overridden by other vampires. Any other Dominate user attempting to countermand your instruction on the subject must spend an extra Willpower Trait and bid two extra Traits on the test.
system.duration: As long as the original command stands

items.name: Dominate — 3 Advanced — Speak Through the Blood

system.description: Spend a permanent Willpower Trait and win a Mental Challenge against any vampire of your own bloodline, regardless of distance, to implant a broad, generic long-term command (specific or immediate orders are not possible). The command lasts five years per permanent Willpower Trait spent, gradually shaping the subject's agenda without her realizing the source, and combines potently with powers like Mass Manipulation. A vampire who reaches Golconda becomes immune, though unknowingly so.
system.duration: Five years per permanent Willpower Trait

system.description:
Named for the legendary (and supposedly fae) progenitor of the houses of Anjou and Lusignan, this power lets a Toreador sway others through song. If the Artisan can phrase her request in the form of a song, her words take on the weight of a nigh-irresistible command.

System: The player states the suggestion she wishes to weave into the song and describes the song's nature. Everyone within earshot must resist or unknowingly submit to the request. The effect lasts as long as the Toreador continues singing or until the target leaves her presence; commands requiring the victim to leave the singer's presence can be resisted once more after the enchanting voice fades. Listeners outside the Toreador's immediate presence may notice something odd about the performance, though it registers as little more than an exceptionally fine one; other Toreador within earshot are immediately entranced. As a side benefit, knowledge of this power makes the character a superlative singer even when the power itself is not invoked.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)
system.duration: As long as the Toreador continues singing, or until the target leaves her presence

items.name: Presence — 3 Advanced — Pulse of the City

system.description: Your emotional state is always passively mirrored by the population of an entire city-sized region, with visitors affected less strongly than residents and vampires affected one level more mildly than mortals. To deliberately project a chosen emotion, spend a Willpower Trait and win a Static Social Challenge (typically 10-15 Traits, Storyteller's call) to shift the city's mood for one minute, extendable by spending additional Social Traits before the challenge. Two Methuselahs with this power contesting the same city test the Social Challenge directly against one another, with the longer-established Methuselah (six months or more) gaining five bonus Traits. Usable even while in torpor.
system.bloodCost: One Willpower Trait (plus Social Traits to extend duration)
system.duration: One minute per activation, longer with extra Social Traits spent

system.description:
A diplomat's most difficult task is understanding what people need to hear to make them agreeable to a suggestion. With this power, a Toreador learns what a target wants to hear. It does not reveal the target's full views, but it grants invaluable insight that can be put to use in negotiation, avoiding treachery, or worse — enemies may be allied, marriages arranged, and wars started with proper application of this knack.

System: The character concentrates on her subject and, on success, knows what to say to elicit a particular response. If she is attempting to advance an idea the target believes fundamentally wrong (convincing a pacifist monk to propose war, or a happy person to consider suicide), the target may resist. The effect lasts for the remainder of the conversation.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)

system.description: By spending a Blood Trait, you gain a further additional action at the end of the turn, on top of any gained from Swiftness.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description:
Assamites who hone both their preternatural senses and their speed learn a valuable secret: sometimes it is wiser to defend than to attack. A vampire with this power enters a brief trance in which she perceives every threat against her at once, assessing and reacting to each in turn.

System: At the start of a combat turn, before actions are declared, the player spends two Blood Traits and a Willpower Trait to activate this power (this counts as activating Celerity for the turn). The character takes no offensive action that turn, but may defend against every attack made against her, contesting each one individually. This power may be used no more than a number of times per scene equal to the character's Perception Trait total.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens

system.description: A combination power blending Potence's unnatural strength with Fortitude's supernatural toughness, letting a Cainite brace her whole body against blunt-force impacts: falling, car crashes, explosions, or being struck by very large objects. It does not help against ordinary combat damage (fists, bullets, blades) or against fire, electricity, sunlight, or other energy-based damage — only against impacts affecting the entire body, and only if the character can see the impact coming and brace for it.
system.source: Mexico City by Night, Chapter Five: Storytelling (Unique Abilities)

system.description: When you suffer lethal or bashing damage, you may make a Simple Test (improved by spending a stamina-related Physical Trait) to remove one level of that damage entirely; usable once per attack, and may be combined with Resilience.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

vtmlarp.source: San Francisco by Night, Chapter Five: Honored Shen
